prompt: To make the ether CH₃–O–CH(CH₃)₂ by Williamson synthesis, which combination is BEST?

options.label: CH₃ONa + (CH₃)₂CHBr → likely E2 (secondary halide, strong base)
(CH₃)₂CHONa + CH₃Br → clean SN2 on 1° methyl halide

explanation: For an unsymmetrical ether, pick the combination with the LESS hindered alkyl halide (SN2 wants 1° > 2° > 3°). Methyl halides are ideal. The alkoxide can be any size — only the alkyl halide needs to be unhindered.
